_schema: Continuous validation baselines. Each entry stores the reference AUC-PR for a monthly IEDB benchmark; the workflow alerts on a >3% relative drop. A null auc_pr means the baseline has not yet been established, so the gate refuses to report a regression verdict until a reviewed value is committed.

iedb_ebv_hpv16_tcell.note: EBV + HPV16 IEDB T-cell export scored with the pinned feature_mode=31 production model. Establish the baseline through review and commit it here; subsequent runs compare against the stored value.
